Class AlgoHoldingGainLossService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoHoldingGainLossService
@Service public class AlgoHoldingGainLossService extends Object
The gain or loss of an actual holding, measured against what it cost.

The holding alert used to compare the last price with the previous close, which is the movement of the market since yesterday and says nothing about the position: an instrument bought years ago at half the price reports a loss on any red day. What the alert is specified to measure is the position's own performance against its cost basis, with a short position gaining when the price falls.

The calculation is not reimplemented here. It walks the tenant's transactions through SecurityCalcService, the same average cost accounting the portfolio reports use, and asks the resulting position for the percentage it would show. An alert and the report the user then opens therefore cannot disagree. Everything is in the currency of the instrument, which is also the currency of the price the alert compares, so no exchange rate enters into it.

    • positionGainLossPercentage

      public Optional<Double> positionGainLossPercentage(Integer idTenant, Security security, double price)
      The percentage gain or loss of a tenant's open position in one instrument at a given price.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - the tenant whose transactions define the position
      security - the instrument
      price - the price to value the position at, in the instrument's currency
      Returns:
      the signed percentage, positive for a gain in the direction the position is held, or empty when the tenant holds no open position in the instrument, or when its cost basis is zero and a percentage is therefore undefined
